title: L2 Engineer - Platform & Agentic Ops
description:
About the Role

The L2 Engineer – Platform & Agentic Ops bridges core infrastructure operations, platform reliability, and autonomous AI agent operations (Agentic Ops). In this intermediate role, you act as the operational backbone for enterprise platforms hosting microservices, data workflows, and multi-agent AI systems. You will handle escalations from Level 1 support, diagnose platform anomalies, trace AI agent execution failures (e.g., tool-call loops, prompt regressions, and token overruns), and maintain high availability across cloud environments. This position works closely with Platform, DevOps, and AI/ML Engineering teams to automate runbooks, optimize agentic workflows, and maintain platform stability.

Responsibilities

* Agentic Ops & Telemetry Analysis: Monitor autonomous AI agents and execution runtimes. Debug multi-step agent workflows, handle failed tool calls/function calling, resolve context-window and token budget limits, and mitigate runaway loops or infinite retry chains.
* Platform Operations & Incident Management: Serve as an escalation point (L2) for production incidents, service degradations, and system alerts across Kubernetes clusters, API gateways, and cloud infrastructure.
* Observability & Distributed Tracing: Instrument and monitor end-to-end telemetry across both traditional infrastructure and LLM/agent pipelines (inspecting spans from prompt $\rightarrow$ routing $\rightarrow$ retrieval $\rightarrow$ tool execution).
* Automation & Runbook Engineering: Convert repetitive manual fixes into automated scripts, self-healing jobs, or standardized Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to empower L1 teams.
* Cost & Quota Governance: Track, manage, and enforce rate limits, model routing thresholds, and API credit/token consumption across foundation model providers and vector databases.
* CI/CD & Deployment Support: Assist in deploying, validating, and rolling back platform services, prompt configurations, agent definitions, and model gateway updates safely.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Partner with L3/core engineering teams on detailed post-mortems for major platform or agentic pipeline failures.

Requirements

* Experience: 2–4 years in Systems Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Platform Operations.
* Scripting & Programming: Proficiency in Python (essential for agent runtimes and automations) or Bash/Go/Node.js.
* Cloud & Containerization: Practical experience operating and debugging within containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Agentic & LLM Fundamentals: Foundational understanding of how LLMs and agent frameworks function—including tool/function calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, context window management, and prompt handling.
* Observability Stack: Hands-on experience with logging, metric, and tracing tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Networking & APIs: Solid grasp of REST APIs, gRPC, JSON schemas, webhooks, authentication (OAuth/IAM), and HTTP status debugging.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Clear documentation skills, disciplined troubleshooting under SLA constraints, and effective cross-functional communication.

Nice to Have

* Agentic Framework Exposure: Direct operational experience with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* LLM Tracing & Evaluation Tools: Familiarity with LLM observability tools such as LangSmith, Phoenix (Arize), Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.
* Vector Databases: Operational familiarity with vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, pgvector).
* Workflow Orchestrators: Exposure to durable execution engines or workflow tools (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, Prefect).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Basic knowledge of Terraform or Helm for managing platform components.
* Certifications: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator / Solutions Architect Associate, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or cloud AI certifications.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
About the Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) – Cloud Management & Operations Platform is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operational support, customer satisfaction, and service reliability for an enterprise multi-tenant cloud management platform. In this leadership role, you manage a tiered operational organization comprising L1 (Incident Monitoring & Triage), L2 (Platform & Agentic Operations), and L3 (SRE & Core Platform Escalations) teams. You will act as the primary operational liaison between external enterprise customers and internal engineering organizations. You will own Service Level Agreements (SLAs/SLOs), drive major incident governance, lead post-incident reviews (RCAs), optimize support workflows, and spearhead continuous operational improvements to minimize customer downtime and maximize adoption of the cloud management platform.

Responsibilities

* Tiered Team Leadership & Resource Management: Direct, mentor, and allocate resources across 24/7/365 L1, L2, and L3 support teams. Define shift coverage, on-call rotations, escalation matrices, and technical career progression pathways for support engineers.
* SLA/SLO Ownership & Service Governance: Accountable for meeting contractual Service Level Agreements (MTTA, MTTR, availability targets) across all customer accounts. Maintain live service health dashboards and deliver periodic operational reviews (QBRs/MBRs) to customer leadership.
* Major Incident Management (MIM): Act as the executive incident commander during Critical/P1 outages impacting customer cloud environments or platform availability. Direct the cross-functional resolution bridge, manage external crisis communications, and eliminate operational bottlenecks.
* Problem Management & RCA Delivery: Partner with L3 engineers, SREs, and product engineering to lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following outages. Track post-incident corrective and preventative action items (CAPAs) to ensure systemic platform vulnerabilities are resolved.
* Operational Shift-Left & Automation: Drive "shift-left" operational strategies—empowering L1 teams to resolve recurring issues through automated runbooks developed by L2/L3 engineers, thereby reducing MTTR and tier-escalation volume.
* Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling: Serve as the designated operational escalation contact for enterprise customer stakeholders. Manage client friction, track recurring customer pain points, and translate operational findings into feature requests for the product roadmap.
* Vendor & Tooling Operations: Oversee support tools and platforms, including ITSM systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), paging systems (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), and client-facing status portals.

Requirements

* Experience: 7–12 years in IT service management, technical support leadership, or cloud infrastructure operations, with at least 3+ years directly managing multi-tiered technical teams (L1/L2/L3) in a B2B SaaS, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or Cloud Platform setting.
* ITSM & Framework Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management), with demonstrated experience tailoring frameworks to agile cloud environments.
* Cloud & Platform Technical Acumen: Broad understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud operational paradigms (monitoring, log ingestion, and API-based integrations).
* Incident & Crisis Leadership: Proven track record acting as Incident Commander or escalation manager during complex, high-impact enterprise production outages.
* Metrics & Analytics Driven: Strong ability to track, analyze, and present operational KPIs (Ticket Volume, First-Contact Resolution, SLA Breaches, MTTA/MTTR trends, CSAT) using reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Jira dashboards).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical failures and remediation steps clearly to C-level client executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional, PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
* Cloud Certifications: Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900).
* DevOps & SRE Alignment: Experience transitioning traditional ITSM support structures toward modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and error budget management.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep administrative experience configuring workflows, SLAs, and routing rules inside ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* FinOps/Contract Knowledge: Exposure to cloud economics, consumption models, and managing operational support profitability (P&L tracking, statement of work commitments).

title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers.
